title: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection
layout_note: A 2 x 4 grid of photos: rows are two example scenes, columns are settings of increasing text understanding (closed-set categories, novel categories, referring sentences) plus an application column split off by a black vertical rule. Group labels (a), (b), (c) in bold run along the bottom, a brace spans the two open-set columns.
grouping: Each column has a tinted header pill (green for pre-defined categories, blue for the two human-input columns, peach for the application column). A double-headed arrow across the top, coloured green at the left end and blue at the right, is labelled 'Object localization' and 'Text understanding' at its two ends. Grey footer bars name the task under the columns.
shapes_depth: The content is all photos: predicted boxes drawn as thin coloured rectangles directly on the images, the text prompt printed in plain type under each image ('bench', 'ear, lion, bench', 'The left lion'). Blue arrows with a dot at the source run from a detection image to the edited image in the application column, whose prompt is written in grey under it.
proposed_highlight: No method diagram; the teaser shows the task. Columns are ordered so the same image moves from fixed categories to free text, the top arrow names that axis, and the header-pill colours group the proposed open-set columns apart from the closed-set one.
lesson: Order a detection teaser's columns along one named axis (fixed categories, novel words, referring sentences) on the same photos, with the text prompt printed under each image and the boxes drawn on it, so the reader sees the task widen.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2303.05499); venue ECCV as recorded from Semantic Scholar, the venue's year not verified. All images are photos (18 embedded images recorded by refs crop). Annotation note (2026-11-15): teaser of tasks and results, not a method figure; architecture/training set to other (not depicted)

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.note: teaser of tasks and results, not a method figure; architecture/training set to other (not depicted)

core.what: task settings as photo columns side by side under one double-headed axis arrow from 'Object localization' to 'Text understanding', the same two photos repeated in each column

relations.form: columns (a) closed-set COCO categories, (b) novel categories and reference sentences, each with a tinted header, the prompt printed under each photo, and detection boxes drawn on the photos
the lions photo and the World Cup photo recur in every column of (a) and (b), so only the prompt and the boxes change
a vertical rule separates (c) image editing; blue arrows with dot ends run from detections in (b) to the stable-diffusion edited images, with the edit prompt below each

channels.colour: header tint = setting (green closed-set, blue open-set, orange application); box outline colours = individual detections, varied per instance; the blue-to-green gradient on the top arrow = the localization-to-text axis
channels.shape: photos = data, tinted pills = task headers, grey bars = task names
channels.line: double-headed gradient arrow = ordering axis; blue dot-ended arrows = detections handed to editing; a vertical black rule = boundary of the application part
channels.frame: no frames; groups (a)/(b)/(c) named by bracket captions at the bottom

quality.strengths: Repeating the same two photos across columns isolates what changes (the prompt and its boxes), and the top axis arrow turns the column order into a stated progression; the application part is fenced off by a rule.
quality.weaknesses: Detection boxes are thin multicoloured outlines on busy photos, unreadable at print size (especially the crowd); header tint, box colour and arrow colour all use blue/green with unrelated meanings; the model itself is not drawn, so this is a task overview rather than a method diagram.

insights.structure: Three captioned groups left to right: (a) closed-set detection, (b) open-set detection with two columns (novel categories, referring sentences), separated by a vertical rule from (c) image-editing application.
insights.data: Two real photos (lions, World Cup crowd) repeated in each column with coloured detection boxes and the text prompt printed under each image; edited results appear in (c).
insights.emphasis: A double-headed arrow across the top labelled 'Object localization' to 'Text understanding' orders the columns along one axis so the task visibly widens.
insights.flow: Left to right across columns; blue arrows with dot ends carry detections into the stable-diffusion edits.
insights.avoid: Small coloured boxes on busy crowd photos are hard to read at print size.

arrangement.units: unframed photo columns with tinted category headers, grouped by captions (a)/(b)/(c) and a vertical rule before the application
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos with the text prompt printed below each
arrangement.shared: the same two photos repeated in every column
